title: Local Bifurcations from Single-Mode Traveling Waves in the Filamentation Equation
summary: We study local bifurcations from the single-mode traveling wave family of the filamentation equation on the torus, within the real positive-frequency Sobolev space $X^s$. A Fourier null structure removes the apparent derivative loss and makes the traveling wave map real analytic for $s>3/2$. Its linearization splits into finitely many coupled two-mode blocks, a carrier block, and a diagonal high-frequency tail.
